text:
maya: Quick ask — can we assemble a 1-page "field flashcard" that the sales team can drop into demos? Focus: enterprise security, SLA guarantees, and deploy-mode decision pointers (hosted vs dedicated vs private). Need something scannable for AMs.

sam: Yep. Suggest 3 sections: (1) Security & compliance quick wins, (2) SLA/latency/cost tradeoffs, (3) Deploy-mode decision table with example customer profiles. Keep each section 3 bullets max.

olivia: For SLAs, do we have a short line on p99 latency and availability targets for Dedicated vs Hosted? Sales will ask for numbers in calls.

leo: Draft lines:
- Security: SOC2 Type II, optional VPC/private control plane, KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs export.
- SLA: Hosted: best-effort, published SLOs on console; Dedicated: 99.9% uptime, latency SLOs configurable by pool size; Private: SLA by contract.
- Deploy mode guidance: "If you need fast time-to-value -> Hosted; predictable throughput & isolation -> Dedicated; data residency/regulatory controls -> Private."

sam: Add one measurable benchmark bullet under SLA: typical p95 token latency numbers for common configs (e.g., 70ms p95 for small gen workloads on Dedicated medium pool, ~120ms Hosted average). Mark as "typical" and call out workload variance.

olivia: Also include an inbound routing note: which leads go to self-serve vs sales-assisted. Quick rule: <$100k ARR -> self-serve + hosted; enterprise security or >1M tokens/mo -> sales-assisted (Dedicated/Private).

maya: Love it. Can we make the copy even more bite-sized — think 6–8 lines total on page front, with a backside "if they ask for benchmarks" with a tiny table? AMs want something they can skim live.

leo: Proposed front (6 lines):
1) SOC2 Type II, optional VPC & KMS, audit logs.
2) Hosted = fastest TT V; Dedicated = committed GPU pools (99.9% uptime); Private = on-prem/VPC for regulated workloads.
3) Typical p95: Dedicated ~70–120ms, Hosted ~100–200ms (highly workload dependent).
4) Cost levers: batching, KV caching, quantization — we handle recommendations.
5) Routing rule: self-serve if < $100k ARR or <1M tokens/mo, else sales-assisted.
6) CTA: "Request Dedicated evaluation" or "Start free hosted trial" (linkable buttons).

olivia: Backside (benchmarks) quick table idea: columns: workload type, p95 hosted, p95 dedicated, notes. Keep three rows: small gen, long context chat, embeddings batch.

maya: Perfect. One ask: call out compliance add-ons (extended log retention, custom audit exports) as an enterprise upsell line.

sam: I'll stitch a visual layout for the AM slide + a one-pager PDF. pinging @launch-bot for asset template.

launch-bot: Asset template: https://internal.assets/redwood/marketing/field-flashcard-template_v2.sketch — use 3:2 portrait, primary CTA slots, include legal footnote area.

leo: I'll drop the first draft copy into the template and share by EOD. Anyone want to review before I hand to design?

maya: Yes — @sam and @olivia please review. Target to hand to design tomorrow noon PST.

olivia: I'll do a pass after lunch and add the benchmark table numbers (will flag any numbers that need legal/infra signoff).

sam: Cool. I'll add the inbound routing blurb and two suggested CTAs (one for self-serve, one for sales).

maya: Thanks team — goal: GA to field by end of week for upcoming webinar. Keep it tight and no jargon. :rocket:
